paras: Pseudocalotes dringi, also known commonly as Dring's false bloodsucker and Dring's false garden lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Malaysia.
The specific name, dringi, is in honor of British herpetologist Julian Christopher Mark Dring.
P. dringi is found in Peninsular Malaysia.
The preferred natural habitats of P. dringi are forest and shrubland, at an altitude of 1,500 m (4,920 ft).
P. dringi is diurnal and arboreal.
